title: English Rance Collection
description:
A collection of everything Rance that's been translated to English AFAIK.

>What's in this pack?
Old Timeline
Little Princess
Little Vampire
Rance I Digest
Rance II Digest
Rance III
Rance IV
Rance 4.1
Rance 4.2 
Kichikuou Rance

Canon Timeline
Rance 01
Rance 02
Rance IV
Rance 5D
Rance VI
Sengoku Rance
Rance Quest

>What isn't in this pack?
Rance 03 (currently untranslated)
Rance IX (translation in progress)
Rance X (translation in progress)

Extras
Doujinshi
Evenicle Rance 1+2
Darkness Hero Rance (mod for Sengoku)
Sengoku original fantranslation
Rance 02 original fantranslation
Slash Thrust Burn (Sengoku spin-off)
Rance original game
Rance II original game
Rance 01 OVA
Rance 1994 OVA
Kichikuou booklet

>What order should I play them in?
IMO it doesn't really matter that much. I would say just play the Old timeline then the Canon. Keep in mind that a lot of people 
started with Sengoku and played the older games later. You're fine if you skip Little Princess, Little Vampire, 4.1, and 4.2.
For a quick intro to the series I would recommend
III-->VI-->Sengoku

>POTENTIAL ISSUES
Everything seems to work perfectly fine on Windows 10. 
Apparently Kichikuou may have sound issues; I haven't encountered any. However, I have encountered a no sound issue with some of the
games. This is likely due to ny sound setup. I fixed these issues by setting my playback device to the default speakers, then starting
the game, and switching my playback device to my normal device.
